subject: Finalizing Compliance Pack for SIG: SOC 2 + PT Exec Summary + ISO Attestations
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@medcorecorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medcorecorp.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG evidence — final checklist and timelines

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of the SIG review we need a consolidated compliance pack to close our security review and move the contract to procurement. Specifically, MedCore needs the following:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Executive summary of the latest penetration test (high/critical findings summarized)
- ISO attestations (scope + statement)
- A short security overview deck for our security committee (10 slides max)

Can you confirm you can provide these by end of day today or, if not, your earliest ETA? Also let me know if you need any additional paperwork from our side (NDA already signed).

Cheers,
Alyssa
Alyssa Grant
Security Program Manager
MedCore Health

--
Alyssa Grant
MedCore Health
alyssa.grant@medcorecorp.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@medcorecorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence — final checklist and timelines

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks — we can deliver a consolidated bundle. Quick note on scope and timing: SOC 2 Type II (covering 2026 audit period) and the ISO27001 attestation are ready. The full pen test report is restricted; we can provide an executive summary that highlights any high/critical findings and remediation status. The security deck will be tailored for the committee (privacy, data residency, incident response summary, and attestation points).

ETA: I can get the executive summary + deck to you by 3pm PT today and the SOC 2 / ISO PDFs will be attached in the same package. If you need a signed attestation or redaction for the pen test, flag it now — we can route a redaction request through our security team but that may add a business day.

Will send the bundle with a Drive link and attachment stubs.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@medcorecorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence — consolidated compliance pack (attachments)

Alyssa — attaching the bundle as discussed. See file list below and a short note on each item.

Attachments: 4 files (SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf; PenTest-ExecutiveSummary-Redwood-2027.pdf; ISO27001-Attestation-Redwood-2026.pdf; Redwood-Security-Overview-Deck-2027.pptx)

Notes:
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf: Licensed report PDF, redacted per policy to remove client-specific callouts. Full report available under NDA + S3 access if required.
- PenTest-ExecutiveSummary-Redwood-2027.pdf: Executive summary only; no raw findings or exploit code included. We confirm there were no unresolved critical findings. Medium/low items have remediation timelines attached.
- ISO27001-Attestation-Redwood-2026.pdf: Attestation letter from our registrar listing scope (Redwood Inference production services) and effective date.
- Redwood-Security-Overview-Deck-2027.pptx: 10-slide deck focused on controls, incident response, encryption, key management, and data residency.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MC-4521/compliance-pack
DocuSign (for attestation signature if needed): https://app.docusign.com/MC-4521/sig-request

If you need any additional evidence (e.g., log retention screenshots, audit logs, or ID of third-party sub processors), say which items and we’ll surface them.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Head of Trust & Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa.grant@medcorecorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@medcorecorp.com
Date: 2027-05-30T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG evidence — consolidated compliance pack (attachments)

Tessa,

Appreciate the quick turnaround — received the drive link and attachments. A couple of small asks from the security committee before we close the SIG:
1) Can you confirm the pen test vendor name and whether testing included internal (network) and external (perimeter) scopes?
2) For SOC 2, can you provide the cover page with the period stated in plain text (some of our reviewers prefer a one-line summary in the separate PDF for reference)?
3) We may need the ISO attestation signed; if so, can you route the DocuSign link to procurement@medcorecorp.com?

If you can reply to the three bullets and route the signature today, procurement will start the final contract paperwork.

Best,
Alyssa
--
Alyssa Grant
Security Program Manager
MedCore Health
Alyssa.grant@medcorecorp.com
